{{MissingInfo|1|java|}} [[File:Concetta.png|thumb|250px|Concetta]] '''Concetta''' (Japanese: '''キャル''' ''Cal'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is a [[Pokémon Performer]]. ==History== [[File:Sara Lee and Concetta SM.png|thumb|220px|Concetta and Sara Lee in Kanto]] Concetta first appeared in ''[[XY091|A Performance Pop Quiz!]]'' as a participant in the [[Anistar City]] [[Pokémon Showcase]] Rookie Class. In the Theme Performance, she competed against {{an|Blanche}} and another Performer, but failed to make it to the Freestyle Performance. In ''[[XY105|Party Dancecapades!]]'', Concetta was seen attending a dance party hosted by [[Monsieur Pierre]]. Concetta later competed in the {{ci|Fleurrh}} Showcase Rookie Class in ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'', where she once again failed to make it past the Theme Performance. In ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'', Concetta competed in the Pokémon Showcase Master Class in [[Gloire City]]. In the first round, she went up against [[Nini]] and [[Jessie|Jessilee]]. Her performance did not get enough votes from the audience, however, and she was placed in the third spot of the group. She appeared alongside [[Sara Lee]] in the [[Poké Problem]] segment of ''[[SM043|When Regions Collide!]]'', where they were shown wearing casual clothes and carrying their luggage at an airport in [[Kanto]]. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Concetta |pkmn=Scraggy |gender=male |type1=Dark |type2=Fighting |img=Concetta Scraggy.png |vajp= |vaen=Jason Griffith |epnum=XY091 |epname=A Performance Pop Quiz! |desc={{p|Scraggy}} first appeared in ''[[XY091|A Performance Pop Quiz!]]'', where he participated in the {{ci|Anistar}} {{pkmn|Showcase}} Rookie Class. In the Theme Performance, Scraggy competed against {{an|Blanche}}'s {{p|Meowstic}} and a {{p|Mightyena}}, but lost. Scraggy reappeared in ''[[XY105|Party Dancecapades!]]'', where he attended a dance party hosted by [[Monsieur Pierre]]. In ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'', he participated in the {{ci|Fleurrh}} Showcase Rookie Class. In the Theme Performance, his opponents were [[Serena's Braixen]] and {{TP|Serena|Pancham}}, and [[Kazalie]]'s {{p|Lilligant}}. However, he and his Trainer were once again unable to proceed to the Freestyle Performance. He appeared again in ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'', where he competed in the {{ci|Gloire}} Showcase Master Class. In the first round, he went up against [[Nini]]'s {{p|Smoochum}} and [[Jessie's Gourgeist]]. His performance didn't get enough votes from the audience, however, and he and his Trainer once again got third place. Scraggy appeared again in the [[Poké Problem]] segment of [[SM043]], where he and his Trainer were seen standing in an airport in [[Kanto]]. Scraggy's known moves are {{m|Focus Blast}}, {{m|Brick Break}}, and {{m|Ice Punch}}.}} ==Showcases== ===Princess Keys obtained=== This listing is of the {{DL|Pokémon Showcase|Princess Key}}s Concetta has obtained: * At least three Princess Keys (prior to ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'') ===Master Class ranking=== Concetta has achieved the following ranking in the Master Class tournament: * {{ci|Gloire}} Showcase - {{tt|Top 28|Round 1, third in her individual group}} (''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'') ===Other achievements=== Concetta has competed in the following Rookie Class tournaments: * {{ci|Anistar}} Showcase - Theme Performance (''[[XY091|A Performance Pop Quiz!]]'') * {{ci|Fleurrh}} Showcase - Theme Performance (''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{dark color}}|bordercolor={{fighting color}} |ja= |en=[[Sarah Natochenny]] (Kiri)
